items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: what’s the other band Wayne Shorter was in?

ctx.x: Yeah I can recall seeing him in I guess it was the early 70s when he had this “Return to Forever” like, high-impact jazz fusion. And he’s quite a guy.
Yeah, listen he changed the jazz world along with, what’s the other band Wayne Shorter was in?
